mavzu: Unit 4 - Lesson 3: I want to be a football player

savollar.savol: Matnda ko'rsatilgan professionlardan biri qaysi?
"I like running and playing football" gap qaysi kasbga mos?
"I like cars" gap qaysi kasbga mos?
"I love cooking" gap qaysi kasbga mos?
"My favourite subjects are Uzbek and English" gap qaysi kasbga mos?
"I am good at playing the piano" gap qaysi kasbga mos?
Homework da "My granny was a ___" qaysi kasb?
Homework da "My grandad was a ___" qaysi kasb?
Homework da "My mum is a ___" qaysi kasb?
Homework da "My dad is a ___" qaysi kasb?
Agar siz "I like running and playing football" desan, qaysi kasbni xohlaysiz?
Agar siz "I like cars" desan, qaysi kasbni xohlaysiz?
Agar siz "I love cooking" desan, qaysi kasbni xohlaysiz?
Piyononi o'yna qilish fani qaysi kasbda muhim?
"Read and complete" bo'limida nechta bo'sh joy to'ldiriladi?
Matnda nechta "I want to be" so'z birikmasidan ishlatilgan?
Homework bo'limida oilaning nechta a'zosining kasbi ko'rsatilgan?
Agar siz "I am good at playing the piano" desan, qaysi kasbni xohlaysiz?
Homework da "My granny was" va "My mum is" ifodalarida qanday farq ko'rinib turadi?
"My favourite subjects are Uzbek and English" gap qaysi kasbining asosiy sababiga ko'rsatma?
Agar biror kisi ham futbols sevgan ham pishiringni sevgan bo'lsa, u nechta kasbdan birini xohlashi mumkin?
Homework da oilaning nechta a'zosining o'tgan zamon kasbi ko'rsatilgan?
Matnning "Read and complete" va "Homework" bo'limlarida "teacher" kasbi nechta bor?
Agar biror kisi "I like music" va "I am good at playing the piano" desan, u aniq qaysi kasbni xohlaydi?
"Read and complete" bo'limidagi misol (e.g.) bilan bir xil tuzilmada nechta gap berilgan?
Homework bo'limida oilaning kasblari orasida, eng ko'p o'tgan zamon kasblar qaysi?
"I like music" gap berilsa va "I am good at playing the piano" bo'lsa, qaysi kasb aniq mos kelib qoladi?
Matnning "Read and complete" va "Homework" bo'limlarida hammasida ko'rsatilgan kasblarning umumiy sonini hisoblang (takrorlangan kasb ham sanab)
Homework bo'limida o'quvchi o'zi qaysi kasbni xohlashini ko'rsatuvchi gap qaysi?
variantlar: I want to be a teacher
My dad is a police officer

savollar.savol: Matnda "footballer" so'zi ko'rsatilganmi, yoki boshqa shaklida yozilganmi?
